payload.summary: Playwright: six assertions read a count once instead of retrying
payload.detail: tests/ui-formulation-result-cards.spec.ts:52, tests/ui-smoke.spec.ts:3211 and 3212, tests/ui-on-call-boards.spec.ts:563, 690 and 771 use expect(await locator.count()) which never retries, so a slow render fails the test. Next action: switch each to expect.poll(() => locator.count()) with the same matcher, or toHaveCount where the count is exact.
payload.source: Design, front-end and test review 2026-09-27 (Claude Code session: web-design-guidelines, frontend-checklist-global, playwright-best-practices, codebase-design skills), re-verified on main a3fee8d1a
